_doc: Smooth motion (story 16.13, camera/motionMath.js, camera/Motion.js, entities/PlayerMotion.js). reducedMotion: the data default of the flag (the family or entry 15 Effekte setting saves shared.flags.reducedMotion through the settings.reducedMotion state action; a saved flag wins over this default); with it on there is no shake, no hit-stop, no squash, no bob, no breathing and no camera look-ahead, and door fades are short. lookAhead: the camera aims `distance` world px ahead of the kid, reached at `speedFor` px/s, eased with `response` per second; it is off in co-op (the fit zoom and the tether own the view). cycle: stride frames advance by distance (`stepLen` world px per step; a 4-step cycle of stride A, standing, stride B, standing), `moveFrom` px/s is the speed above which a kid counts as moving, `runFrom` px/s switches walk to run frames (`runStepLen`), bob: px the body rises between strides; bike.stepLen: px per half turn of the pedals. breathe: the standing figure rises one base px while the breathing sine at `rate` Hz is above `above`. squash: preset scales of the sprite (sx, sy at the extreme, `time` s, eased back to 1): land is a small squash of the standing kid (mounting, dismounting), rideJump stretches a rider along its heading, rideLand squashes it, hop is the bike bell and mounting hop. transition: door and map fades (`out` and `in` s, `hold` s at black, `reduced` is both under reducedMotion). shake: presets of whole-base-pixel camera offsets (amp px, `time` s, `hz` wobble rate, decays). hitStop: presets of `time` s at `scale` times normal speed. events: which game events trigger which presets (phase: only that phase of the event).
